name: hero-liquid-metal
title: Hero Liquid Metal
description: A split landing hero: a large two-line heading, short paragraph, pill button and two tech badges on the left, and a rounded block of iridescent liquid metal on the right. Concentric teal rings keep rolling across the glossy surface.
use: A product page wants a premium metallic visual that moves on its own beside or behind the headline.
avoid: A perpetual WebGL shader that needs a sized parent, with a fixed glossy teal palette tied to this demo.
a11y: A hidden h1 names the hero and the link carries text, but the constant shader motion ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a left column stacks a big white two-line heading, a dim grey paragraph, an outlined pill button and two bordered badges. The right side is a rounded-rectangle slab of glossy metal, its dark surface crossed by bright teal and pale cyan concentric rings.
behaves: The rings ripple and slide across the metal like slow waves, so highlights and dark bands keep trading places. The text and controls hold still; hover lifts the button and badges, and on small screens the metal becomes a dimmed band under the copy.
customise: All copy, CTA and badges arrive as props, and the shader takes width, tint, distortion, speed and repetition. Layout and the metal shape need class or source edits.
weight: heavy: A liquid-metal WebGL shader keeps rippling every frame across half the hero.
demo: Heading AI SDK Agents / Copy and Paste, copy about Vercel AI SDK, Next.js v16 and AI SDK v6 badges.
issues: The description is small and dim against black, so it is hard to read at a glance.
polishWhy: Convincing glossy metal and a balanced split; the small dim body copy is the weak point.
